name: Orianna
notes: Orianna auto-attacks throughout the fight so Clockwork Winding is always active: each attack deals bonus magic damage scaled by the stacks generated by the two previous attacks (0/1/2), then adds/refreshes its own stack, capped at 2 and lasting 4 s.

Command: Attack (Q) is cast on the dummy as soon as it is off cooldown; the open question of whether it hits once or twice is settled here as a double hit (the Ball passing through the target on the way in, plus the 70%-damage arrival impact on the same spot), since landing the Ball on top of the target for that double proc is the common way it is played.

Command: Dissonance (W) and Command: Protect (E) are cast on cooldown; E is assumed to still land its pass-through damage on the dummy every cast even though it is self-targeted, since Orianna is assumed to be standing next to the dummy so the Ball's short return trip crosses it. E's shield and the passive bonus resistances from the attached Ball are purely defensive and are not modeled.
Command: Shockwave (R) is cast at the opening (t = 0, after its 0.5 s cast) and again on cooldown for the rest of the fight; its stun/pull have no effect on a stationary dummy.
The 0.01 s global ability cooldown The Ball imposes on casts is far below anything that matters here and is not modeled.
Mana costs and movement speed / slow effects are not modeled: nothing here plausibly runs a level-16 build out of mana inside the fight, and movement never matters against a stationary dummy.
